halves.note: A component that only works in one half is a schedule artefact, not a model.

scope: margin/total engine only — see V13 for the absence term

settlement_cross_check.unit: points per game; MAE is the number a bettor actually cares about because it is what has to beat the spread to make money

gates.name: Out-of-sample, no look-ahead
gates.threshold: ratings window must end strictly before the first graded game
gates.detail: Enforced by construction: the ratings come from the DateFrom/DateTo window data/live/team_windows.json → window_fit, and nothing in this module reads the test-window rows except to score them.

gates.name: Sample floor
gates.detail: n=51. Every interval below is wide for the reason this gate exists: a 51-game window cannot separate a 12.79 MAE from a 13.19 MAE. This gate FAILS and the desk says so instead of reporting the difference as skill.

gates.name: Beat the naive baseline on margin
gates.detail: Model MAE 12.836 against a pick-nothing baseline around 13.2 on the same games; the gap is well inside the bootstrap interval, so this is a PASS only in the 'not obviously worse' sense.

gates.name: Calibration of the win probability
gates.detail: Probability is derived from the projected margin over a fixed σ. It is honest as a calibration check and useless as a betting number, because there is no price to compare it to.

gates.name: Stability across halves
gates.threshold: both halves same sign of error, n >= 20 each
gates.detail: Both halves are large enough to read and the error does not swing wildly, but 25-game halves still cannot detect a small bias.

gates.name: Uncertainty published
gates.threshold: every headline figure carries an interval
gates.detail: Block bootstrap with block=5 (a five-game stretch ≈ a week of a team's schedule), fixed seed so a reviewer gets the same interval.

gates.name: Provenance of every row
gates.threshold: every published table row links an official host
gates.measured: enforced by common.assert_official at load time
gates.detail: A row whose source is not an NBA property raises, so it cannot reach the page. The rendered site re-checks with scripts/check_links.py.

gates.name: Rotation reassignment
gates.threshold: role-player minutes reallocatable from verified data
gates.detail: Only 1 of the 26 official absences for 11/14 has verified season minutes inside this repository (the per-game points file is page 1 of 465 rows; the minutes file stops at rank 24). Vacated minutes therefore reduce the named star's production and are NOT re-spread across his teammates — the model under-states replacement offence on purpose.
gates.missing_input: the remaining ~415 rows of players_traditional and the minutes leaderboard past rank 24

gates.name: Availability completeness
gates.threshold: both teams filed for every priced game
gates.measured: 0 of 5 games have both sides filed; 5 of 5 have exactly one side filed
gates.detail: One team in each 11/14 game was still NOT YET SUBMITTED when the report was captured. The adjustment is asymmetric by construction, so any line on those games carries an unquantified error bar.
gates.missing_input: the next edition of the official injury report (filed the evening before)

gates.name: Market comparison / closing line value
gates.threshold: beat the close on a tracked price
gates.detail: No sportsbook price is reachable from this sandbox, so there is no break-even rate, no ROI, no CLV and no hold. Nothing in this repo may be described as +EV, and 'the model beats the market' cannot be tested here at all.
gates.missing_input: any historical price feed (closing line per game is the minimum viable version)

gates.name: Pricing of props and parlays
gates.threshold: a prop line needs the player's own game log
gates.detail: The dispersion machinery exists and is measured (integration/props.py) but 12 player-games across 3 players cannot price a slate. Prop and SGP numbers are published with usable_for_staking=false on every row.
gates.missing_input: per-game logs for every player in the slate — one page fetch per player, already proven reachable

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.measured: deterministic: fixed-seed LCG bootstrap, no RNG, no wall-clock in any figure
gates.detail: The only time-dependent value is the capture stamp, which is copied from data/live/capture_meta.json rather than read from the clock, so a rebuild is diffable.

gates.name: Out-of-sample test of the absence adjustment
gates.threshold: needs official reports for the graded window
gates.detail: The live line carries a new-absence term (0.35 pts per vacated team-minute-share), but no official injury report exists in this repository for 2026-11-06..11-12, so that term is not covered by any number in this file. It is an assumption under test, not a validated feature.
gates.missing_input: back-copies of the NBA.com injury report (one PDF per day at the same URL pattern), or any archive of them

summary.decision: The line model is not worse than a naive pick and its components survive ablation on 51 games, but V2/V9/V11 FAIL and V8/V10 are BLANK. Nothing on this desk is validated, and no gate was loosened to change that.
